paragraphs: SubItUp sells workforce scheduling and time-management software for shift-based teams. The platform builds staff schedules, lets employees swap and pick up shifts without manager intervention, tracks hours with a built-in time clock, and exports hours worked straight to payroll. A built-in time clock can turn any internet-enabled device into a clock-in point, and hours reconcile automatically before they reach payroll.

The pages name higher education, municipal parks and recreation, healthcare, retail and franchise, and live events among the settings the software is built for. Staff can add, drop, and swap their own shifts with peers, and a manager approves the swap once staff agree to it. Managers set the maximum hours staff can work by role and location, including across teams within one organization.
Payroll exports are built for platforms including ADP, Intuit QuickBooks, Oracle PeopleSoft, Workday, and Paychex. Pricing is based on the number of employees scheduled, with a 10-employee minimum.

quote.text: Social Scheduling™ is SubItUp's answer to the extra time managers spend trying to find coverage after employees drop a shift.
